Figure 2 Aurora pipeline. The Aurora VLM agent (a LoRA-finetuned Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct [24]) parses the raw user request, triggers tools, rewrites the instruction, and routes the task. The output is the unified conditioning tuple (𝑦′, 𝑉𝑠𝑟𝑐, 𝑅+) that the Aurora video diffusion transformer consumes; the task label is part of the agent plan and supports the instruction rewrite, but is not fed to the video model.
